items.statement: Real estate agents often avoid making calls in visible areas and seek seclusion instead.

items.quote: Embrace visibility and let accountability elevate your skills
items.statement: Visibility and accountability can help elevate skills in sales and client conversations.

items.quote: Would you do push-ups with the same effort and quality if you were alone at home
items.statement: Do not hide when making client calls; instead, seek visibility for better feedback and skill development.

overview: Post discussing the importance of accountability and visibility in sales practices, specifically for real estate agents.
